_comment: Camera presets. az 0 = looking at the product front (camera on the -Y side), positive az moves the camera toward +X; el = degrees above the horizon. Distance is solved so the framed box fits with `margin` (fraction of the frame left free on the tightest side). type PERSP or ORTHO. target: 'product' (whole product), 'region:top|bottom|front|left|right' (that quarter of the bbox), or 'component:<id or label>'. dof.fstop is the real f-number on a 36 mm sensor; omit dof for none.
